cues: An old village minister steps out of his front door at sunset and says a short prayer aloud.
He does not ask for money, or rain, or for his enemies to be punished.
He asks God to look kindly on every creature that is born to die, and to give his town one more day.
Then he says good night to the sun: good-bye, but just for now.
